description: This file defines the interface and class structure for the WarningReportingUnit component, including nested classes for settings and JSON serialization, as well as internal buffer management and control mechanisms.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Main class managing warning reporting, including category controls, buffer management, and event reporting.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::Setting
classes.description: Represents a configurable setting for a warning category, including JSON serialization support.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::JSON
classes.description: JSON container class for serializing and deserializing WarningReportingUnit settings.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::ReportingBuffer
classes.description: Internal class extending Core::CyclicBuffer to handle data buffering with synchronization via Core::DoorBell.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of WarningReportingUnit.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Open
methods.description: Opens the warning reporting unit with a specified identifier or path.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Announce
methods.description: Signals that new data is available in the buffer.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Acknowledge
methods.description: Acknowledges the data in the buffer has been processed.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Wait
methods.description: Waits for data availability or buffer space.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::UpdateEnabledCategories
methods.description: Updates the list of enabled categories based on JSON configuration.
